## Overview

This document compares modelled cycling connectivity between same-bank and opposite-bank docking stations. Thirty distinct station pairs are sampled across three direct-distance bands. Cached OSRM bicycle routes are compared with straight-line connections using detour ratios, additional distances and bank-to-bank transitions. Contrasting case studies and directional journey counts contextualise the results. The analysis is exploratory and does not establish a causal effect of the Thames.


```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(osrm)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)
library(ggspatial)
library(scales)

dir.create("outputs/web", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Consistent project colour palette
col_station <- "#173F5F"
col_thames <- "#82B5D1"
col_cross <- "#D97706"
col_same <- "#64748B"
col_background <- "#F5F5F2"
```

```{r import-network-inputs}
stations_bng <- readRDS(
  "data/processed/stations_classified.rds"
)

od_pairs <- readRDS(
  "data/processed/od_classified.rds"
)

thames_bng <- readRDS(
  "data/processed/thames_bng.rds"
)

banks <- readRDS(
  "data/processed/river_banks.rds"
)

# Inspect the available OD relationships
count(od_pairs, relationship)

# Confirm spatial compatibility
stopifnot(
  st_crs(stations_bng) == st_crs(banks),
  st_crs(stations_bng) == st_crs(thames_bng)
)
stopifnot(st_crs(stations_bng) == st_crs(27700),
          !anyDuplicated(stations_bng$station_id),
          !anyDuplicated(od_pairs[c("origin_id", "destination_id")]))
```

```{r construct-sampling-population}
eligible_directional <- od_pairs |>

  filter(
    relationship %in% c("Same-bank", "Cross-river"),
    direct_km >= 0.5,
    direct_km < 3
  ) |>

  mutate(
    distance_band = cut(
      direct_km,
      breaks = c(0.5, 1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("0.5–1 km", "1–2 km", "2–3 km"),
      right = FALSE
    ),

    # Identify reciprocal station pairs
    pair_id = paste(
      pmin(origin_id, destination_id),
      pmax(origin_id, destination_id),
      sep = "_"
    )
  )

# Randomly retain one direction per station pair
set.seed(476)

eligible_pairs <- eligible_directional |>
  slice_sample(prop = 1) |>
  distinct(pair_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Inspect available pairs within each stratum
count(eligible_pairs, distance_band, relationship)
```

```{r select-routing-sample}
set.seed(476)
sample_file <- "data/processed/routing_sample.rds"

# Generate the original stratified design using the same sampling procedure.
candidate_sample <- eligible_pairs |>
  group_by(distance_band, relationship) |>
  slice_sample(n = 5) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(distance_band, relationship) |>
  mutate(route_id = paste(origin_id, destination_id, sep = "_"))

# Preserve the original route IDs if the earlier sample exists. Refresh all
# attributes from the latest OD data rather than reusing stale attributes.
if (file.exists(sample_file)) {
  original_sample <- readRDS(sample_file)
  pool <- eligible_directional |>
    mutate(route_id = paste(origin_id, destination_id, sep = "_"))
  idx <- match(original_sample$route_id, pool$route_id)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(idx), !anyDuplicated(idx))
  routing_sample <- pool[idx, ]
  stopifnot(identical(as.character(routing_sample$relationship),
                      as.character(original_sample$relationship)),
            identical(as.character(routing_sample$distance_band),
                      as.character(original_sample$distance_band)))
} else {
  routing_sample <- candidate_sample
}

sample_summary <- routing_sample |> count(distance_band, relationship)
stopifnot(nrow(routing_sample) == 30L,
          nrow(sample_summary) == 6L, all(sample_summary$n == 5L),
          !anyDuplicated(routing_sample$pair_id),
          !anyDuplicated(routing_sample$route_id))
sample_summary
saveRDS(routing_sample, sample_file)
```

```{r configure-routing}
options(
  osrm.server = "https://routing.openstreetmap.de/",
  osrm.profile = "bike"
)

# Directory for cached network routes
dir.create(
  "data/processed/route_cache",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
# The existing analysis is cached. Explicitly opt in only if rebuilding
# missing routes, subject to the public service's usage policy.
allow_live_routing <- FALSE
```

```{r define-routing-function}
get_cycle_route <- function(pair) {
  cache_file <- file.path("data/processed/route_cache",
                          paste0(pair$route_id, ".rds"))
  origin <- c(pair$origin_lon, pair$origin_lat)
  destination <- c(pair$destination_lon, pair$destination_lat)
  stopifnot(length(origin) == 2L, length(destination) == 2L,
            all(is.finite(c(origin, destination))))

  valid_route <- function(route) {

  inherits(route, "sf") &&
    nrow(route) == 1L &&
    isTRUE(is.finite(route$distance) & route$distance > 0) &&
    isTRUE(is.finite(route$duration) & route$duration > 0) &&
    !is.na(st_crs(route)) &&
    isTRUE(st_geometry_type(route) == "LINESTRING") &&
    isTRUE(st_is_valid(st_transform(route, 27700))) &&
    !any(st_is_empty(route))
}

  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
    cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
    # Legacy caches predate explicit profile/server fields. They were
    # created by the original bicycle-routing configuration in this project.
    profile_ok <- is.null(cached$profile) || identical(cached$profile, getOption("osrm.profile"))
    server_ok <- is.null(cached$server) || identical(cached$server, getOption("osrm.server"))
    if (identical(cached$origin, origin) &&
        identical(cached$destination, destination) &&
        profile_ok && server_ok && valid_route(cached$route)) {
      route <- cached$route
      route$route_id <- pair$route_id
      route$retrieved_at_utc <- if (is.null(cached$retrieved_at)) NA_character_ else
        format(cached$retrieved_at, tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE)
      return(route)
    }
  }

  if (!allow_live_routing) {
    stop("Missing or incompatible cached route: ", pair$route_id,
         ". Check the cache before enabling live requests.")
  }
  Sys.sleep(1.2)
  route <- osrmRoute(src = origin, dst = destination, overview = "full")
  stopifnot(valid_route(route))
  route$route_id <- pair$route_id
  retrieved_at <- Sys.time()
  route$retrieved_at_utc <- format(retrieved_at, tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE)
  saveRDS(list(origin = origin, destination = destination, route = route,
               retrieved_at = retrieved_at, profile = getOption("osrm.profile"),
               server = getOption("osrm.server")), cache_file)
  route
}
```

```{r calculate-network-routes}
route_list <- vector("list", nrow(routing_sample))
routing_errors <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(routing_sample))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(routing_sample))) {
  message("Processing route ", i, " of ", nrow(routing_sample))
  # Single-bracket assignment preserves list length even when a route fails.
  result <- tryCatch(get_cycle_route(routing_sample[i, ]), error = identity)
  if (inherits(result, "error")) {
    routing_errors[i] <- conditionMessage(result)
    route_list[i] <- list(NULL)
  } else {
    route_list[i] <- list(result)
  }
}

successful <- !vapply(route_list, is.null, logical(1))
routing_audit <- data.frame(route_id = routing_sample$route_id,
                            successful = successful, error = routing_errors)
readr::write_csv(routing_audit, "outputs/routing_audit.csv")
table(successful)
# Do not silently change the analytical sample if requests fail.
if (!all(successful)) {
  print(routing_audit[!successful, ])
  stop("Incomplete routing sample. Resolve the failed routes before comparing groups.")
}
routes_sf <- do.call(rbind, route_list)
stopifnot(identical(routes_sf$route_id, routing_sample$route_id))
```

```{r calculate-network-efficiency}
routes_sf <- routes_sf |>

  rename(
    network_km = distance,
    network_min = duration
  ) |>

  left_join(
    routing_sample,
    by = "route_id"
  ) |>

  mutate(
    detour_ratio = network_km / direct_km,
    extra_km = network_km - direct_km,
    extra_distance_pct = (detour_ratio - 1) * 100
  )

# Inspect the analytical variables
routes_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(
    origin_name,
    destination_name,
    relationship,
    direct_km,
    network_km,
    detour_ratio
  ) |>
  head(10)
# Attach observed demand in both directions, retaining directional route costs.
pair_demand <- od_pairs |>
  mutate(pair_id = paste(pmin(origin_id, destination_id),
                        pmax(origin_id, destination_id), sep = "_")) |>
  group_by(pair_id) |>
  summarise(both_directions_journeys = sum(journeys), .groups = "drop")
routes_sf <- routes_sf |> left_join(pair_demand, by = "pair_id")
stopifnot(nrow(routes_sf) == 30L,
          all(routes_sf$both_directions_journeys >= routes_sf$journeys))
```

```{r validate-network-results}
stopifnot(
  all(st_is_valid(st_transform(routes_sf, 27700))),
  all(is.finite(routes_sf$detour_ratio)),
  all(routes_sf$direct_km > 0)
)

# Compare docking station coordinates with OSRM's snapped route endpoints.
routes_bng <- st_transform(routes_sf, 27700)
origin_xy <- st_coordinates(stations_bng[match(routes_sf$origin_id,
                                               stations_bng$station_id), ])
destination_xy <- st_coordinates(stations_bng[match(routes_sf$destination_id,
                                                    stations_bng$station_id), ])
snap_metrics <- t(vapply(seq_len(nrow(routes_bng)), function(i) {
  xy <- st_coordinates(st_geometry(routes_bng)[i])[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]
  a <- xy[1, ]; b <- xy[nrow(xy), ]
  c(origin_snap_m = sqrt(sum((a - origin_xy[i, ])^2)),
    destination_snap_m = sqrt(sum((b - destination_xy[i, ])^2)),
    snapped_direct_km = sqrt(sum((a - b)^2)) / 1000)
}, numeric(3)))
routes_sf$origin_snap_m <- snap_metrics[, "origin_snap_m"]
routes_sf$destination_snap_m <- snap_metrics[, "destination_snap_m"]
routes_sf$snapped_direct_km <- snap_metrics[, "snapped_direct_km"]
routes_sf$snapped_detour_ratio <- ifelse(routes_sf$snapped_direct_km > 0,
  routes_sf$network_km / routes_sf$snapped_direct_km, NA_real_)

# Flag rather than silently delete anomalous distances. A 50 m endpoint
# threshold is a diagnostic choice, not a validated accuracy standard.
route_quality <- routes_sf |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(route_id, origin_name, destination_name, origin_snap_m,
         destination_snap_m, direct_km, snapped_direct_km, network_km,
         detour_ratio, snapped_detour_ratio) |>
  mutate(flag = origin_snap_m > 50 | destination_snap_m > 50 | detour_ratio < 1)
summary(routes_sf$detour_ratio)
summary(c(routes_sf$origin_snap_m, routes_sf$destination_snap_m))
route_quality |> filter(flag)
readr::write_csv(route_quality, "outputs/route_quality.csv")

# All six strata must still have five valid modelled routes.
actual_sample <- routes_sf |> st_drop_geometry() |> count(distance_band, relationship)
stopifnot(nrow(actual_sample) == 6L, all(actual_sample$n == 5L))
```

## Comparative Network Efficiency

Network efficiency is compared within three distance bands to reduce the influence of geographical separation on the comparison between same-bank and cross-river connections.


```{r compare-distance-bands}
band_summary <- routes_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(distance_band, relationship) |>
  summarise(
    routes = n(),
    median_direct_km = median(direct_km),
    median_network_km = median(network_km),
    median_detour = median(detour_ratio),
    median_extra_km = median(extra_km),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

band_summary

# Residual distance imbalance within each stratum and sensitivity to snapping.
band_comparison <- inner_join(
  band_summary |> filter(relationship == "Cross-river") |>
    select(distance_band, cross_direct_km = median_direct_km,
           cross_detour = median_detour),
  band_summary |> filter(relationship == "Same-bank") |>
    select(distance_band, same_direct_km = median_direct_km,
           same_detour = median_detour), by = "distance_band"
) |> mutate(direct_gap_km = cross_direct_km - same_direct_km,
            detour_gap = cross_detour - same_detour)
band_comparison

snap_sensitivity <- routes_sf |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(distance_band, relationship) |>
  summarise(routes = n(),
            median_station_detour = median(detour_ratio),
            median_snapped_detour = if (all(is.finite(snapped_detour_ratio)))
              median(snapped_detour_ratio) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop")
snap_sensitivity
```


## Route-Based River Crossing Analysis

Modelled cycling routes are examined to identify transitions between the north and south banks of the Thames. This allows endpoint classifications to be distinguished from the actual geographical structure of the modelled route.


```{r define-crossing-function}
# Transform routes to British National Grid
routes_bng <- st_transform(routes_sf, 27700)

# Reconstruct the extent of the bank classification
study_extent <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(banks))
river_geom <- st_union(st_make_valid(thames_bng))

count_crossings <- function(route, origin_bank,
                            destination_bank, spacing_m = 5) {

  # Densify the route at intervals no greater than spacing_m metres
  dense_route <- st_segmentize(
    route,
    dfMaxLength = spacing_m
  )

  # Extract ordered coordinates along the route
  coords <- st_coordinates(dense_route)

  route_points <- st_as_sf(
    data.frame(
      x = coords[, "X"],
      y = coords[, "Y"]
    ),
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = 27700
  )

  # Check whether the route leaves the classification area
  outside <- any(
    lengths(st_covered_by(route_points, study_extent)) == 0
  )

  # Classify each point by river bank
  matches <- st_intersects(route_points, banks)

  point_banks <- vapply(
    matches,
    function(x) {
      if (length(x) == 1) {
        return(as.character(banks$bank[x]))
      }
      NA_character_
    },
    FUN.VALUE = character(1)
  )

  # Non-bank points should fall within the river, not an unclassified land gap.
  unknown <- which(is.na(point_banks))
  unexpected_gap <- length(unknown) > 0L && any(
    lengths(st_intersects(route_points[unknown, ], river_geom)) == 0L
  )

  # Check that route endpoints agree with station banks
  endpoints_match <- isTRUE(
    first(point_banks) == origin_bank &
    last(point_banks) == destination_bank
  )

  # Remove points between the banks
  bank_sequence <- point_banks[!is.na(point_banks)]

  # Collapse consecutive points occupying the same bank
  transitions <- rle(bank_sequence)$values

  # Count changes between banks
  crossings <- if (
    outside || unexpected_gap || !endpoints_match || length(transitions) == 0
  ) {
    NA_integer_
  } else {
    length(transitions) - 1L
  }

  crossings
}
```


```{r calculate-river-crossings}
# Use two spacings to detect sensitivity to vertex density.
classify_routes <- function(spacing) {
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(routes_sf)), function(i) {
    count_crossings(st_geometry(routes_bng)[i], routes_sf$origin_bank[i],
                    routes_sf$destination_bank[i], spacing_m = spacing)
  }, integer(1))
}
counts_5m <- classify_routes(5)
counts_2m <- classify_routes(2)
routes_sf$river_crossings <- ifelse(!is.na(counts_5m) & !is.na(counts_2m) &
                                     counts_5m == counts_2m,
                                   counts_5m, NA_integer_)
# Retain an audit trail for ambiguous routes.
crossing_audit <- data.frame(route_id = routes_sf$route_id,
                             crossings_5m = counts_5m, crossings_2m = counts_2m,
                             final_crossings = routes_sf$river_crossings)
readr::write_csv(crossing_audit, "outputs/crossing_audit.csv")
crossing_summary <- routes_sf |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(relationship, river_crossings)
crossing_summary
```

```{r investigate-double-crossings}
double_crossings <- routes_sf |>
  filter(
    relationship == "Same-bank",
    river_crossings >= 2
  )

double_crossings |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(
    origin_name,
    destination_name,
    direct_km,
    network_km,
    detour_ratio,
    river_crossings
  )

# Validate crossing counts against endpoint classifications
routes_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(
    is.na(river_crossings) |
    (relationship == "Same-bank" &
       river_crossings %% 2 != 0) |
    (relationship == "Cross-river" &
       river_crossings %% 2 != 1)
  )
```

## Contrasting route case studies

The highest-detour connection in each group in the shortest distance band illustrates route indirectness on both sides of the river. These deliberately selected extremes are not representative examples.

```{r select-route-cases}
case_studies <- routes_sf |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(distance_band == levels(routing_sample$distance_band)[1]) |>
  group_by(relationship) |>
  arrange(desc(detour_ratio), route_id, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |> ungroup() |>
  mutate(case_group = if_else(relationship == "Cross-river",
                              "Case A: opposite banks", "Case B: same bank")) |>
  select(case_group, route_id, relationship, origin_name, destination_name,
         direct_km, network_km, detour_ratio, extra_km, network_min,
         journeys, both_directions_journeys, river_crossings)
stopifnot(nrow(case_studies) == 2L)

# Maximum departure from the straight-line segment, measured in metres.
# For a polyline and a straight segment, the maximum occurs at a vertex.
case_studies$max_offset_m <- vapply(case_studies$route_id, function(id) {
  route_i <- match(id, routes_bng$route_id)
  direct_i <- match(id, sample_sf$route_id)
  xy <- st_coordinates(st_geometry(routes_bng)[route_i])[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]
  vertices <- st_as_sf(as.data.frame(xy), coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = 27700)
  max(as.numeric(st_distance(vertices, st_geometry(sample_sf)[direct_i])))
}, numeric(1))
case_studies

# A screening table, not an infrastructure investment ranking. Both-direction
# demand describes the connection; routing cost is for the sampled direction.
demand_screen <- routes_sf |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(route_id, relationship, origin_name, destination_name, distance_band,
         journeys, both_directions_journeys, direct_km, network_km,
         detour_ratio, extra_km) |>
  group_by(distance_band) |>
  mutate(band_median_journeys = median(both_directions_journeys),
         band_median_detour = median(detour_ratio),
         above_both_sample_medians = both_directions_journeys > band_median_journeys &
           detour_ratio > band_median_detour) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(desc(above_both_sample_medians), desc(both_directions_journeys),
          desc(detour_ratio), route_id)
head(demand_screen, 10)
```

  routes_map$route_id,
  sample_sf$route_id
)

  st_transform(sample_sf[direct_index, ], 4326)

  filter(

      routes_sf$destination_id

```{r figure-3-route-explorer, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Use route and direct-line bounds, not the full Thames geometry.
route_bbox <- st_bbox(c(st_geometry(routes_map), st_geometry(direct_map)))
map_bounds <- as.numeric(route_bbox[c("xmin", "ymin", "xmax", "ymax")])
# Line width encodes detour ratio; use a fixed mapping for both groups.
route_weight <- function(x) 2 + 2 * pmax(0, x - 1)

fig3 <- leaflet(width = "100%", height = 560,
                options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE, scrollWheelZoom = FALSE)) |>
  addTiles(options = tileOptions(opacity = 0.35)) |>
  addPolygons(data = st_transform(thames_bng, 4326),
              fillColor = col_thames, fillOpacity = 0.25,
              stroke = FALSE, group = "River Thames",
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))

# Separate toggleable groups for same-bank and cross-river network/direct lines.
for (rel in c("Same-bank", "Cross-river")) {
  r <- routes_map[routes_map$relationship == rel, ]
  d <- direct_map[direct_map$relationship == rel, ]
  colour <- if (rel == "Cross-river") col_cross else col_same
  network_group <- paste(rel, "routes")
  direct_group <- paste(rel, "direct lines")
  fig3 <- fig3 |>
    addPolylines(data = d, color = colour, weight = 2, opacity = 0.85,
                 dashArray = "6, 6", popup = ~popup, group = direct_group) |>
    addPolylines(data = r, color = "#FFFFFF", weight = route_weight(r$detour_ratio) + 2,
                 opacity = 0.9, options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE),
                 group = network_group) |>
    addPolylines(data = r, color = colour, weight = route_weight(r$detour_ratio),
                 opacity = 0.95, popup = ~popup,
                 label = ~paste0(origin_name, " → ", destination_name),
                 highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 7, opacity = 1,
                                                     bringToFront = TRUE),
                 group = network_group)
}

# Individually toggleable case layers, including their direct connections.
for (i in seq_len(nrow(case_studies))) {
  k <- match(case_studies$route_id[i], routes_map$route_id)
  r <- routes_map[k, ]; d <- direct_map[k, ]
  colour <- if (r$relationship == "Cross-river") col_cross else col_same
  group <- case_studies$case_group[i]
  fig3 <- fig3 |>
    addPolylines(data = d, color = colour, weight = 3, dashArray = "5, 6",
                 opacity = 1, group = group, popup = ~popup) |>
    addPolylines(data = r, color = "#FFFFFF", weight = 8, opacity = 1,
                 group = group, options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)) |>
    addPolylines(data = r, color = colour, weight = 5, opacity = 1,
                 group = group, popup = ~popup,
                 label = ~paste0(origin_name, " → ", destination_name))
}

fig3 <- fig3 |>
  addCircleMarkers(data = sample_stations, radius = 4, color = "#FFFFFF",
                   weight = 1, fillColor = col_station, fillOpacity = 1,
                   label = ~station_name, group = "Docking stations") |>
  addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("Cross-river routes", "Same-bank routes",
                                    "Cross-river direct lines", "Same-bank direct lines",
                                    case_studies$case_group, "Docking stations", "River Thames"),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) |>
  addLegend(position = "bottomright", colors = c(col_cross, col_same),
            labels = c("Cross-river", "Same-bank"),
            title = "Station relationship", opacity = 1) |>
  addControl(html = "Thicker solid lines = higher detour ratio<br>Dashed lines = direct connections",
             position = "bottomleft") |>
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE)) |>
  fitBounds(map_bounds[1], map_bounds[2], map_bounds[3], map_bounds[4]) |>
  hideGroup(c("Cross-river direct lines", "Same-bank direct lines", case_studies$case_group))

# Fit after the HTML widget has its actual display dimensions; preserve all routes.
fig3 <- htmlwidgets::onRender(fig3, '
  function(el, x, b) {
    var map = this;
    map.whenReady(function() {
      map.invalidateSize();
      map.fitBounds([[b[1], b[0]], [b[3], b[2]]], {padding: [28, 28]});
    });
  }', data = map_bounds)
fig3
```

```{r figure-4-network-efficiency, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
plot_data <- routes_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(
    relationship = factor(
      relationship,
      levels = c("Same-bank", "Cross-river")
    )
  )

median_labels <- plot_data |> group_by(distance_band, relationship) |>
  summarise(detour_ratio = median(detour_ratio), .groups = "drop")

# Offset the labels horizontally from the jittered observations.
fig4 <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = relationship,
    y = detour_ratio,
    colour = relationship
  )
) +

  # Perfectly direct connection reference
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = col_same,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  # Individual modelled cycling connections
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.12,
      height = 0,
      seed = 476
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # Group median
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 95,
    size = 12
  ) +

  geom_text(data = median_labels,
            aes(label = sprintf("%.2f×", detour_ratio)),
            position = position_nudge(x = 0.19), hjust = 0,
            fontface = "bold", size = 3.4, show.legend = FALSE) +

  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.45, 0.85))) +

  # Separate panels for comparable distances
  facet_wrap(~distance_band, nrow = 1) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Same-bank" = col_same,
      "Cross-river" = col_cross
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = function(x) sort(unique(c(1, pretty(x, n = 5)))),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "×")
  ) +

  labs(
    title = if (all(band_comparison$detour_gap > 0))
      "Cross-river connections show greater median detours" else
      "Network detours by station relationship",
    subtitle = paste0(
      nrow(plot_data),
      " modelled connections | Five per group and distance band"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Network detour ratio",
    caption = paste0(
      "Points represent individual station pairs; ",
      "horizontal markers and labels show group medians.\n",
      "Dashed line: a perfectly direct connection (1.00×).\n",
      "Sources: TfL Santander Cycles | ",
      "OpenStreetMap | OSRM bicycle routing"
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = col_background,
      colour = NA
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = col_background,
      colour = NA
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 22,
      face = "bold",
      colour = col_station
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      colour = col_same,
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      colour = col_same,
      hjust = 0,
      size = 9,
      margin = margin(t = 15)
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      colour = col_station,
      size = 12
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.5, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  )

fig4
```

## Interpretation

The group medians describe the sampled routes, not all journeys. Distance bands reduce but do not remove imbalance in direct distance; the band comparison reports the remaining differences. The two case studies illustrate route indirectness on both sides of the Thames. The modelled routes do not establish actual cyclist paths, the effect of a new bridge or the causal contribution of the river. The screening table flags connections above both sample medians within a distance band. These are relative screening thresholds among the ten sampled connections per band, not investment criteria.
